description: Two first-order axiom sets are equivalent if and only if their consequence closures are equal.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Theories.equivalent_iff_closure_eq.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (T U : L.Theory) :
  Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Theories.Equivalent T U ↔
    Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Theories.consequenceClosure T = Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Theories.consequenceClosure U
